faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 4.0 V6 petrol engine in the Land Rover Discovery 3. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: How do you confirm a 406PN engine fits my Discovery 3?
faqs.a: We check your VIN or registration against the engine code, model year, market specification and gearbox. V6 engines from other vehicles can differ in ancillaries and wiring, so fitment is confirmed before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 4.0 V6 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 3 V6 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the Discovery 3 engine replacement cost for a 406PN?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any ancillary parts required and the labour involved, including body-lift work where needed. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 406PN engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover V6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 406PN engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 4.0 V6?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, the mileage and the value of your Discovery 3 decide the right approach. Coil, vacuum, coolant and oil leak faults can usually be repaired individually. If timing chain failure or severe overheating has damaged the engine, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 3 406PN engine replacement is often more practical.
paragraphs: Because major engine work on the Discovery 3 can involve lifting the body, it makes sense to check related parts at the same time. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, thermostat, hoses and ignition system, and renew the oil, filters and coolant.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery anywhere in the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 3 4.0 V6 Problems
engineProblems.description: The 4.0 V6 often gives warning signs before major failure, so early checks can prevent costly damage.

cards.title: Timing Chain Guide and Tensioner Failure
cards.description: A rattle on start-up or acceleration, rough running or timing fault codes can point to worn timing chain guides, tensioners or stretched chains. We inspect the timing components and chain wear.

cards.title: Coolant Leaks and Overheating
cards.description: A falling coolant level, a sweet smell or rising temperature may come from leaking hoses, the water pump, the thermostat housing or the radiator. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.

cards.title: Head Gasket Problems
cards.description: White smoke, unexplained coolant loss, overheating or a creamy residue under the oil cap may indicate a failing head gasket. We test for combustion gases and check the heads.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Misfires and Coil Pack Faults
cards.description: Juddering, a flashing engine light or a rough idle are often caused by a failing ignition coil, worn spark plugs or injector problems. We test the ignition system cylinder by cylinder.

cards.title: Oil Leaks and Burning Smells
cards.description: Oil drips, smoke from the engine bay or a burning smell can come from ageing rocker cover gaskets, seals or the rear crankshaft seal. We locate the leak and inspect the seals.

cards.title: Vacuum Leaks and Idle Faults
cards.description: A hunting idle, hesitation or lean-running fault codes may relate to vacuum leaks, a faulty breather valve or intake gasket problems. We check for vacuum leaks and read stored faults.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 3 406PN Engine: A Complete 4.0 V6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 3 406PN engine is a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, fitted to Discovery 3 models in certain markets as an alternative to the V8 and diesel options. With age and mileage, timing chain guide wear, coolant leaks, misfires and oil leaks often lead owners to seek a repair or a replacement engine.

The Land Rover 4.0 V6 engine shares its design with V6 units used in other vehicles, but the ancillaries, wiring and engine management differ. We identify the correct Discovery 3 engine by checking your VIN, the engine code and your registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 3 406PN engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
